import json, mlx.core as mx
from airllm import AutoModel

MODEL = "/Volumes/Extreme SSD/airllm-demo/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct"

model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL, layer_shards_saving_path=SPLIT)
config = json.load(open(MODEL + "/config.json"))

print(f"\nclass that ran      : {type(model).__name__}")
print(f"config.json asks for: rope_theta = {config['rope_theta']}")
print(f"this code uses      : rope_theta = {model.model_args.rope_theta}")
